scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm --dir packages/dms-mailing/frontend-vue lint && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-locales.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-frontend-dependencies.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-docs-module-version.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-verify-deps-lockfile.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-module-locks.mts && pnpm --dir packages/dms-mailing exec antelopejs-check-interface-ranges
